name: Drush into Fast Feudal Scouts
goal: Click up at 20 population, harass with 2 Militia, transition into Feudal Scouts.
source: Toaster226 — "Learn Drush | 10 Minute AoE2 Build Orders"
notes: Times are the ideal timeline with zero Town Centre idle time. Real games run 30–60s behind — use the Next button to stay in sync.
Population counts the Scout: 19 villagers + 1 Scout = 20 pop.

steps.action: Build 2 Houses, then gather Sheep under the Town Center
steps.note: Two villagers on the first House, one on the second. All three onto Sheep afterwards.

steps.action: Gather Sheep under the TC
Gather Sheep under the TC
Gather Sheep under the TC
steps.note: 6 on food. Keep the TC producing without a pause.

steps.action: Build a Lumber Camp, then gather Wood
Gather Wood
Gather Wood
steps.note: 3 on wood is exactly what pays for the early Barracks and House.

steps.action: Lure the 1st Boar / Rhino
Gather Boar / Hunt under the TC
Build the 3rd House along your prospective wall line, then join the Hunt
Gather Hunt under the TC — the House builder rejoins Food
Build a Barracks near your base
steps.note: Force-drop wood if you are short of the 175 wood.

steps.action: Gather Hunt / Food under the TC
Gather Hunt / Food under the TC
Barracks completes: queue 2 Militia. The same builder starts the 4th House
steps.note: Queue the Militia the instant the Barracks finishes — they are the whole point of the build.

steps.action: Gather Hunt / Food under the TC
4th House done — that villager returns to Food. Shift 1 villager from Wood back to Food
steps.note: Dropping to 2 on wood keeps food income high enough to click up without the TC idling.

steps.action: Gather Hunt / Food under the TC
Gather Hunt / Food under the TC
Research Feudal Age
Send your 2 Militia + starting Scout toward the opponent's base
steps.note: Focus berries and woodlines. The goal is idle time, not kills.

steps.action: Wood rebalance — put 6 villagers on Wood
Send 6 villagers to build a Mill and gather Berries
steps.note: Berries are food, so the totals do not change — 6 of your 13 food villagers move onto the Mill.

steps.action: Send 1 villager to build a House on your wall line and have it wait to drop a Stable
steps.note: This villager is your Stable builder the instant Feudal lands.

steps.action: Remaining food villagers: finish the hunt, then straggler trees or farms as wood allows
Feudal Age. Research Loom immediately, then queue villagers
Build the Stable with your prepped villager and start producing Scouts
Add farms as wood permits, wall your base, keep double-pronged pressure with Militia + Scouts

followUps.name: Fast Feudal Scouts
followUps.detail: Shown in the video. Maintain maximum map pressure with continuous Scout production.

followUps.name: Fast Castle
followUps.detail: Add 2–4 more villagers in Dark Age, including 2 on Gold, then click up.

followUps.name: Men-at-Arms + Towers
followUps.detail: Fast Feudal into a Man-at-Arms upgrade and a Tower rush on the opponent's economy.
